title: Finite deterministic oracle machine as a nondeterministic machine
statement: Every well-formed finite oracle Turing machine over a symbol alphabet determines a well-formed finite oracle nondeterministic Turing machine over the same alphabet. The resulting machine has the same number of ordinary work tapes and the same finite state set, and its transition function is independent of the nondeterministic choice bit and agrees with the original machine's transition function.
hypotheses_covered: The machine has finitely many states
The query state differs from the positive-answer state
The query state differs from the negative-answer state
The positive-answer state differs from the negative-answer state
